# Rijad Kudumovic – Portfolio

Personal portfolio of Rijad Kudumovic from Mellingen, Switzerland. The site presents his interests and experience in information technology, media design, web development, hardware and video editing.

## Main page
- https://www.rijad.ch/ — Profile, application video, skills, projects, practical experience and application documents available on request.

## Selected projects
- https://www.rijad.ch/MolekuelNT.html — Interactive learning project about molecules.
- https://www.rijad.ch/Periodensystem.html — Interactive periodic table.
- https://www.rijad.ch/PB%20FDP.html — Political education project.
- https://www.rijad.ch/NT.html — Learning page about evolution and speciation.

## External work
- https://www.borntofight.ch — Website project for a Muay Thai gym.
- https://www.10must.ch — Event website project.

The site is written primarily in German and is intended for apprenticeship applications in Informatik and Mediamatik.
